ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; a singular high-contrast circular annulus is present on the lower mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips where peaks become more irregular and jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward curve transition from the median notch to the outer tips on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white ring scar on left lobe; visible barnacle encrustations and associated jagged tissue at the distal tips of both lobes.
